OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY OF MANSFIELD IN NEWTON COUNTY

Whereas, the Department of Transportation currently proposes to make improvements to provide certain safety enhancements on State Route 11 and;

Whereas, the proposed improvements will include a certain area currently utilized for parking and in doing so restrict the sight distance of approaching vehicles, and;

Whereas, the city council of Mansfield support the Department of Transportation proposal to establish a “No Parking Anytime” zone on the (east, west, north, south) side of State Route 11 and the installation of “No Parking Anytime” signs beginning at Mile Log 3.76 and extending this zone to Mile Log 3.91 with the exception of 1 residential parking spot located directly in front of 3122 Hwy 11.

Be it further resolved by the City Council of Mansfield, to request the Newton County Sheriff's Department and the Georgia State Patrol to enforce the “No Parking Anytime” zone established by the Department of Transportation.

A person committing the offense of parking in this designated “No Parking” zone shall be punished by a fine not to exceed $1000.00 or by imprisonment for a period not to exceed 60 days, or both.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed.

This ordinance shall take effect and shall be enforced from and after the date of its adoption and the posting of the appropriate “No Parking” signs.

SO RESOLVED, this _ It day of Ul arch , 2024
